clock: one common clk; cooperative_control uses core_clk on that same net
reset: endpoint/router/capture_control/cooperative_control use rst_n; capture_lease/wrapper/DMA use rst = !rst_n; coordinated upstream and lease/host recovery required
router_capture_select: unsigned full 32-bit address >= 0x00000100; capture_control exactly decodes 0x100..0x17c, rejects everything else
chain_bindings: fpga_v8_capture_control_axil manager-named ports -> same-named fpga_v8_capture_lease ports
address_handling: global AXI128 address in; endpoint scales (address - 0x40010000) >> 2; router forwards that full local address without subtraction/truncation
source_event_boundary: wrapper engine_idle/capture_bank/admitted_sof/publish/publish_seq/retired_error -> manager only; host cannot manufacture publication events
epoch_boundary: manager epoch_start -> idle wrapper epoch restart, after actual config acceptance
generation_policy: host persistent external allocator, never zero or reuse an older epoch while old ACKs may exist; no autonomous allocation
source_stream_policy: incoming unfiltered RGB565 stream requires controlled integration validation; this API does not assert physical camera format or upstream board state
